Marvel's Wolverine is finally here, delivering a polished, visceral single-player action experience on PS5. In this deep dive, we examine Insomniac's latest brawler, highlighting its brutal, satisfying combat, high-fidelity visuals, and impressive environmental destruction. And of course, we check out the fidelity and performance modes on both PS5 and PS5 Pro and take a look at ray tracing and frame-rates.
